battle.name: 卡納戰役
battle.theater: 義大利南部阿普利亞卡納河谷
battle.brief: 卡納戰役（又譯坎尼戰役）是第二次布匿戰爭最具決定性的一役：西元前216年8月2日，漢尼拔在義大利南部阿普利亞的卡納河谷以兩翼騎兵包抄，圍殲羅馬兩執政官聯軍。戰爭年表把此戰繫於前84年，實際交戰在前216年；卡面的埃及長矛是這場戰鬥數千年前的祖型。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 卡納戰役是第二次布匿戰爭中迦太基與羅馬共和國的一次總決戰，交戰的兩邊代表兩套完全不同的國家體制與徵兵制度。迦太基方面由漢尼拔·巴卡統率：骨幹是國家發餉的迦太基非洲重裝步兵與騎兵，外面包著西班牙、高盧、努米底亞與伊庇魯斯盟邦提供的傭兵與輔助兵力；最高執政官與元老院掌握軍費與兵源，首都靠對西班牙的長期徵收維持遠征，古老的公民兵制度早已讓位給職業軍與傭兵制，基層的忠誠靠薪餉與掠奪分配來維繫。羅馬方面是兩名執政官各領一軍的共和國義大利聯軍：核心是按財產等級徵召的羅馬公民兵，輔以拉丁同盟、坎帕尼亞、薩姆尼特等盟邦的輔助步兵與騎兵；軍中以百夫長與十夫長維持基層指揮，執政官代表元老院與人民行使統帥權，兩軍之間的配合靠共處一地的執政官軍體制。西元前216年的執政官是盧基烏斯·埃米利烏斯·保盧斯與馬爾庫斯·克勞狄烏斯·馬爾凱盧斯，前者以資深統帥的身分率大軍進駐亞普利亞平原，後者原本留駐卡西利努姆圍城，聞訊趕來會合。迦太基握有西班牙與西西里東部的基地，羅馬握有地中海的海權與意大利的徵發能力，這個結構差異在戰場上被放大成一句話：一方用騎兵與機動包圍尋求殲滅，另一方用兵員與正面厚度尋求消耗。
countriesEn: The Battle of Cannae was a decisive engagement between Carthage and the Roman Republic in the Second Punic War, and the two sides brought to the field two entirely different state systems and two different ways of raising men. The Carthaginian army was led by Hannibal Barca: its backbone was state-paid Carthaginian infantry and cavalry from Africa, wrapped around by mercenaries and auxiliaries supplied by Spain, Gaul, Numidia and Epirus. The suffetes and the senate in the city controlled the money and the manpower, and the war in Spain was paid for by a permanent system of tribute and taxation levied on the Spanish provinces; the old citizen levy of Carthage had long since given way to a professional army and to the mercenary system, and the loyalty of the rank and file was held together by pay and a share of the plunder. On the Roman side stood the consular army of the Italian confederacy, each consul commanding one part of the field: the core was the Roman citizen levy graded by property, supported by contingents of the Latin League, Campania and Samnium. Centurions and decurions held the ground-level command, the consuls exercised the imperium on behalf of the senate and the people, and the two armies were meant to work together as a single consular force. The consuls of 216 BC were Lucius Aemilius Paullus and Marcus Claudius Marcellus; the older man, Paullus, led the main body into the Apulian plain, while Marcellus, who had been holding the siege of Casilinum, marched to join him when the battle came. Carthage held bases in Spain and in eastern Sicily, Rome held the command of the Mediterranean and the manpower of the Italian peninsula, and that difference in structure is exactly what the field turned into: one side used cavalry and movement to seek encirclement and annihilation, the other used numbers and frontal weight to seek a war of attrition.
people: 卡納戰役的關鍵人物幾乎都留下了可追的文字記錄。迦太基一方，漢尼拔·巴卡是全場的中心：他在前218到前217年間越過阿爾卑斯山，於特雷比亞河、提契諾河與特拉斯梅內湖三戰三捷，把羅馬的執政官軍隊逐一打散，卻始終攻不下羅馬城；卡納一役是他主動選擇在阿普利亞平原求一次總決戰。他的弟弟哈斯德魯巴爾在戰役中率一翼作戰並負傷，侄子馬戈統率右翼騎兵，非洲重裝步兵的指揮交給老將哈米卡，弓箭手與工程勤務則由伊庇魯斯與呂基亞的外籍部隊分擔。最著名的一句話出自努米底亞騎兵首領馬哈爾巴爾：他勸漢尼拔乘勝追入羅馬本土，得到的回答是「你懂得如何贏取一場勝利，卻不懂得如何運用勝利」；事後回看，這句話成了整場戰役的註腳。羅馬一方，執政官盧基烏斯·埃米利烏斯·保盧斯在陣中陣亡，另一名執政官馬爾庫斯·克勞狄烏斯·馬爾凱盧斯帶著殘部退回卡西利努姆；年輕的普布利烏斯·科爾涅利烏斯·西庇阿當時也在軍中，這場災難成了他日後對付漢尼拔的起點。同樣在陣中的昆圖斯·法比烏斯·馬克西穆斯因為留著實力而活下來，日後出任獨裁官，開出拖延消耗的戰略；而在場唯一有文化的目擊者，是被扣在營中當人質的希臘史家波里比烏斯，他把這場戰役寫成《史記》第三卷。
peopleEn: Almost everyone who mattered at Cannae can be followed in the written record. On the Carthaginian side, Hannibal Barca was the centre of the whole day: he had crossed the Alps in 218 and 217 BC and won three battles in a row at the Trebia, the Ticinus and Lake Trasimene, breaking up one Roman consular army after another, yet he had never taken the city of Rome; Cannae was a decision of his own, to force a single decisive battle on the Apulian plain. His brother Hasdrubal commanded a wing and was wounded in the fighting, his nephew Mago led the cavalry on the right, the old handsman Hamilcar took command of the African infantry in the centre, and the archers and the engineering work were handled by the foreign contingents from Epirus and Lycia. The most famous line of the day came from Maharbal, the commander of the Numidian horse: he urged Hannibal to follow the Roman cavalry into Roman Italy and was told that he knew how to win a victory but not how to use one. Read afterwards, that remark turned out to be the whole story of the battle. On the Roman side the consul Lucius Aemilius Paullus fell on the field, while the other consul, Marcus Claudius Marcellus, took the remnants back to Casilinum. The young Publius Cornelius Scipio was in the army as well, and the catastrophe became the starting point of everything he would later do to Hannibal. Quintus Fabius Maximus was in the ranks too and survived because he had kept something in reserve, which is why he was made dictator in 215 BC and set the Roman army on the slow, wearing course that bears his name. The one literate eyewitness on the field was the Greek historian Polybius, held at Hannibal's camp as a hostage, who wrote the battle up as the third book of his Histories.
kits: 卡面上的埃及長矛屬於青銅時代早期早王朝的形制：銅或青銅矛頭纏綁在木杆上，寬而薄的刃口不求穿透，只求在近身格殺時把全身的力氣壓進去；埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。它在這場戰鬥裡的位置得靠時間軸來理解：卡納開打時，這件兵器已經過三千多年的演化，它的後代是希臘重裝步兵的薩里沙長矛、馬其頓方陣兵更長的薩里沙，以及羅馬軍中同樣木杆加青銅矛頭的長矛，形制早被改寫。真正決定西元前216年8月2日那一天勝負的裝備，可以列成這樣一張清單：羅馬步兵以馬尼普爾斯縱隊作戰，基層單位是百人隊，帶盾兵用半圓柱形的羅馬方盾，盾面中央的凸起可以擋開刺擊；拋擲兵器是重型標槍，木杆加鐵製槍頸，擲出後能釘進對方盾牌；手邊的短刀是共和國前期的細長直刃短劍，尚未變成帝國時期的寬身格勞迪斯。迦太基方面，西班牙與高盧步兵用圓形帶中央凸起的卡埃特拉盾，配伊比利亞直刃雙劍或高盧鐮刀形彎刀；巴利阿里島的投石手用麻布或皮製投石索和鉛彈，是全場唯一真正的投射火力；非洲重裝步兵用大盾與短劍，動作接近羅馬式。漢尼拔的裝備表上最醒目的是非洲象，波里比烏斯記他在渡過阿爾卑斯山時有三十七頭，駝著木架衝鋒時用來打散羅馬的縱隊，而象群的失蹄與失控也是這場戰役的變數之一。兩軍的馬匹、運輸與營地同樣是裝備的一部分：羅馬騎兵用小型圓盾與鏈甲，迦太基倚賴努米底亞輕騎兵的快速投射與拉弓；羅馬軍營有壕溝、柵欄與間隔地帶，給養靠每日行軍距離計算；象群與輜重車隊是迦太基速度的枷鎖，這一點在追擊階段屢屢顯現。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card face belongs to the Early Dynastic form of the Bronze Age: a copper or bronze head bound to a wooden shaft, with a broad thin edge that was never meant to pierce but only to put the weight of the body behind at close quarters. The Egyptians used it to hold city walls and later to recover lost ground. Its place in this battle can only be understood on a timeline: by the time Cannae was fought the weapon had been evolving for more than three thousand years, and its descendants were the sarissa of the Greek hoplite, the longer sarissa of the Macedonian phalangite, and the same wooden shaft and bronze head carried as a spear in the Roman ranks. The equipment that actually decided 2 August 216 BC can be set out like an inventory. Roman infantry fought in maniples built on hundreds, the shielded men using the semi-cylindrical scutum whose central boss turns aside a thrust, and their throwing weapon was the heavy pilum, a wooden shaft with an iron shank that could be planted in an opposing shield; the blade at their side was the slim straight short sword of the early Republic, not yet the broad gladius of imperial times. On the Carthaginian side, Iberian and Gallic infantry carried the round caetra with its central boss, with Iberian straight double-edged swords or Gallic falcatas; the Balearic slingers, using slings of cloth or hide and lead shot, provided the only true missile fire on the field; the African heavy infantry used large shields and short swords in a manner close to the Roman way. Most conspicuous on Hannibal's inventory were the African elephants: Polybius records thirty-seven of them when Hannibal crossed the Alps, and they were used in the charge to break up the Roman maniples, while their stumble and loss of control was itself one of the variables in the battle. Horses, transport and camp were part of the equipment as well: the Roman cavalry used small round shields and mail, Carthage relied on Numidian light horse for fast missile work and for the bow, the Roman camp had its ditch, its palisade and its intervallum, and the daily allowance of food was calculated from the day's march. The elephants and the baggage train were the shackles on Carthaginian speed, and that showed again and again in the pursuit.
tactics: 卡納的戰術核心，是漢尼拔放棄正面對撞，主動讓自己的中軍後退，再讓兩翼騎兵繞到羅馬軍背後。迦太基步兵排成新月形的兩道縱線，兩翼是西班牙與高盧兵，內側是持大盾的非洲重裝步兵；羅馬軍以密集縱隊向前推，迦太基中軍按計畫節節後退，兩翼按兵不動，把羅馬步兵壓進一個越來越窄的袋形地帶。等羅馬軍推進到無法再推進，漢尼拔下令兩翼的西班牙與高盧步兵內轉合圍，同時把近萬名騎兵集中在右翼，由馬哈爾巴爾率努米底亞騎兵在羅馬右翼之外展開，擊潰羅馬的聯盟騎兵，再用象群與西班牙騎兵衝擊羅馬左翼，把那一側的羅馬騎兵徹底趕出戰場。漢尼拔自己留在中央，沒有像一般統帥那樣把全軍壓上去，而是留了足夠的預備兵力在身後，防止中軍被反衝擊散。羅馬方面的反應近乎本能：兩名執政官把軍隊排成縱深，步兵以行列密集前推，中央的行列最厚，但正因如此，一旦兩翼被合圍，縱深反而成了被包抄的目標；羅馬騎兵在被打散之後無法重新集結，步兵縱隊互相擠壓，標槍在近身距離內失去威力，盾牌被擠壓成無法揮動。整場戰役的勝負取決於三件事：騎兵對騎兵的結果、迦太基兩翼內轉的時機、以及漢尼拔手中預備隊的使用。追擊階段，迦太基的輕裝兵與騎兵繞過仍在抵抗的羅馬縱隊，把包圍圈收緊，殘存的數千羅馬人與數百騎兵在北面缺口逃出，馬爾凱盧斯帶著他們退回卡西利努姆。地形也站在漢尼拔這邊：陣地選在奧菲多河與山丘夾出的狹長平原上，羅馬軍一旦深入，退路便被己方縱隊與河流堵住，而正午的炎熱與缺糧進一步消耗了羅馬軍的體力。
tacticsEn: The core of Cannae was Hannibal's decision to refuse a frontal clash, to retire his centre deliberately and to send the cavalry on his wings round behind the Roman army. Carthaginian infantry was drawn up in two crescent-shaped lines, Spanish and Gallic troops on the wings and the heavy African infantry with their large shields on the inside. The Romans pushed forward in close columns; the Carthaginian centre gave ground by design, the wings stood still, and the Roman infantry was squeezed into a pocket that kept narrowing. When the Roman army could advance no further, Hannibal turned the Spanish and Gallic troops of both wings inward to close the ring, while concentrating close to ten thousand horsemen on his right, where Maharbal's Numidian cavalry outflanked and broke the Roman allied horse, and the elephants and Iberian cavalry charged the Roman left and swept its horsemen off the field. Hannibal himself stayed in the centre and did not press the whole army forward as a general might; he kept a reserve behind him sufficient to stop the centre being broken by a counter-attack. The Roman response was almost instinctive: the two consuls formed the army in depth, the infantry advanced in dense ranks, and the centre was the thickest part of the line, which is precisely why a closed ring on the wings turned the depth into the target. Once the Roman cavalry was scattered it could not be reassembled, the infantry columns pressed against one another, the pilum lost its power at close range, and shields were compressed until they could no longer be swung. Three things decided the day: the result of the cavalry action, the timing of the inward turn of the Carthaginian wings, and the use Hannibal made of his reserve. In the pursuit, Carthaginian light infantry and cavalry worked round the Roman columns that were still resisting, tightening the ring, and the surviving Romans broke out through a gap to the north with Marcellus and took refuge in Casilinum. The ground was on Hannibal's side as well: the position was chosen in the narrow plain between the Aufidus and the hills, so that once the Romans pushed in, their retreat was blocked by their own columns and by the river, while the heat of midday and the shortage of food wore down the Roman soldiers a second time.
data: 可核的數字大致有兩個來源：波里比烏斯與李維，兩人對同一場戰役的記載略有出入，引用時須分清。時間：西元前216年8月2日，戰役打了一整天，羅馬軍在日落前被圍殲。兵力：波里比烏斯記羅馬軍為八萬步兵與六千騎兵，迦太基軍為四萬步兵與一萬騎兵；羅馬的兵員是公民兵加盟邦輔助兵，迦太基的步兵以西班牙、高盧與非洲兵為主，騎兵一萬中約六千是努米底亞騎兵，李維則把努米底亞騎兵記為四千。象群方面，波里比烏斯記漢尼拔渡阿爾卑斯山時有三十七頭象，羅馬人在卡納是第一次面對成建制的非洲象。損失：波里比烏斯記羅馬方面戰死與被俘合計約七萬人，迦太基軍損失約五千七百人；李維記羅馬方面戰死四萬八千二百人、被俘約三千人，俘虜後來被大批賣作奴隸。殘兵：兩位史家都提到數千名羅馬步兵與部分騎兵逃回卡西利努姆。地理：戰場在阿普利亞的卡納村與奧菲多河之間的平原，兩軍營地相距數里，羅馬軍出營作戰的距離有限，漢尼拔把營地設在北面山丘上控制視線。越嶺：前218年漢尼拔的越嶺大軍，兵員約二萬六千步兵與八千騎兵，穿越阿爾卑斯山用了約五個月，下山到義大利平原又走了半個月。本站的戰爭年表把此戰列於前84年之下，實際交戰年份是前216年，兩者並存於本站資料，引用數字時以史家記載為準。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked come from two main sources, Polybius and Livy, whose figures for the same battle differ slightly and have to be quoted separately. In time: 2 August 216 BC; the fighting lasted a single day, and the Roman army was enclosed before the sun went down. Strength: Polybius gives the Romans eighty thousand foot and six thousand horse, and the Carthaginians forty thousand foot and ten thousand horse; the Roman host was citizens and allied auxiliaries, the Carthaginian infantry was mainly Iberian, Gallic and African, and of the ten thousand riders about six thousand were Numidian, while Livy puts the Numidian horse at four thousand. Elephants: Polybius records thirty-seven when Hannibal crossed the Alps, and at Cannae the Romans met organised African elephants for the first time. Losses: Polybius gives about seventy thousand Romans killed and captured together, against roughly five thousand seven hundred Carthaginians; Livy gives forty-eight thousand two hundred Roman dead and about three thousand prisoners, most of whom were later sold into slavery. Survivors: both historians record that some thousands of Roman infantry with part of the cavalry made it back to Casilinum. Geography: the field lay on the plain between the village of Cannae and the Aufidus, the two camps were a few miles apart, the Romans had little distance to march out of their camp, and Hannibal placed his own camp on the northern hills to hold the ground. The crossing: the army with which Hannibal went over the Alps counted about twenty-six thousand foot and eight thousand horse, spent some five months on the mountains, and needed another half month to come down onto the Italian plain. The war list behind this card files the battle under 84 BC, while the fighting itself belongs to 216 BC; both figures sit in this site's records, and for numbers the historians are the reference.
cause: 打起來的原因，前前後後疊了五層。最底層是迦太基在西班牙的擴張：漢尼拔的父親哈米卡自前247年起在西班牙建城設府，開礦取銀、徵收稅賦，把伊伯利亞半島變成迦太基的資金庫；前226年迦太基與羅馬訂下條約，承諾不越過埃布羅河，前218年漢尼拔卻在未經羅馬同意的情況下渡河，羅馬遂要求迦太基退出薩根圖姆，衝突由此升級。第二層是薩根圖姆的陷落，前219年冬，此事讓羅馬的盟友群起反抗，迦太基必須用兵鎮壓，戰爭從邊界爭端變成全面衝突。第三層是羅馬的反擊：前218年執政官加盧斯在利利巴埃姆擊敗迦太基海軍，執政官西庇阿在埃布羅河會戰中迫使漢尼拔放棄渡河計畫，羅馬看來佔了上風，於是把兩支執政官軍隊派往北意大利，此舉反而把漢尼拔逼上阿爾卑斯山。第四層是漢尼拔本人的戰略判斷：他明白自己兵少、沒有制海權、援軍遙遠，靠劫掠過活的小軍撐不了多久，唯一機會是速戰速決、誘敵決戰、一次解決羅馬的兩支主力；他在前217年的特拉斯梅內湖全殲弗拉米尼烏斯之後，深信羅馬的指揮系統脆弱可乘。第五層是聯盟與錢：前215年迦太基與西西里東部的敘拉古訂約，試圖把羅馬的精力拉向地中海的另一端；羅馬的盟邦提供了大部分騎兵與外圍兵源，兩邊都在用聯盟體系換時間。決戰的到來，是漢尼拔主動在阿普利亞平原設營、並擺出願意在此野戰的姿態，把羅馬兩名執政官一起引來的結果。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting stack up in five layers. At the bottom lies the Carthaginian expansion in Spain: from 247 BC Hannibal's father Hamilcar had been founding cities and administrative centres there, working silver mines and collecting taxes, turning the Iberian peninsula into the treasury of Carthage. In 226 BC Carthage and Rome concluded a treaty undertaking not to cross the Ebro; in 218 BC Hannibal crossed the river without Roman consent, and Rome then demanded that Carthage withdraw from Saguntum, and the dispute escalated. The second layer is the fall of Saguntum in the winter of 219 BC, which set the Roman allies of the lower Ebro rising and obliged Carthage to send troops to hold them down, turning a border quarrel into a general war. The third layer is the Roman counter-offensive: in 218 BC the consul Catulus beat the Carthaginian fleet off Lilybaeum, and the consul Scipio at the Ebro battle forced Hannibal to abandon his plan of crossing in force, so Rome looked to be winning and sent both consular armies into northern Italy, a move that in fact drove Hannibal up into the Alps. The fourth layer is Hannibal's own strategic reading of the situation: he knew he was short of men, without command of the sea and far from reinforcement, and that a small army living on plunder could not last in Italy for long, so his only chance lay in a quick decision, a battle offered and accepted, and the destruction of both Roman armies at once; after wiping out Flaminius at Lake Trasimene in 217 BC he was confident the Roman command system was brittle. The fifth layer is alliance and money: in 215 BC Carthage made a treaty with Syracuse in eastern Sicily in an attempt to pull Roman attention towards the other end of the Mediterranean, while Rome drew most of its cavalry and peripheral troops from its allies, so both sides were using their alliance systems to buy time. The decisive battle came because Hannibal deliberately camped on the Apulian plain and showed himself willing to fight a pitched battle there, which drew both Roman consuls onto the same ground.
impact: 卡納一戰的影響，一半在戰場之內，一半在戰場之外。戰場之內，是羅馬共和國自建國以來最嚴重的一次野戰損失：兩名執政官之一陣亡，兩支執政官軍隊與大批盟邦部隊全滅，羅馬在亞普利亞的野戰能力幾乎歸零，義大利中部與南部大片土地在數月內失去防衛，羅馬城門外第一次出現成建制的敵軍。戰場之外，是整個反漢尼拔戰略的重新排列。既然陸軍需要重建，羅馬把資源轉向海軍與西班牙戰線：前218年派往伊伯利亞的兩支部隊改為攻勢作戰，前206年普布利烏斯·科爾涅利烏斯·西庇阿渡海入西班牙，前209年攻下新迦太基，前207年在庫阿圖斯河擊殺漢尼拔的弟弟哈斯德魯巴爾，切斷迦太基再向義大利輸送兵員與金錢的可能。羅馬在本土則轉入防守與拖延，昆圖斯·法比烏斯·馬克西穆斯於前215年出任獨裁官，以不求速戰、靠小股騎兵擾亂與拖延供應的辦法消耗漢尼拔，這套做法後來被叫做費邊戰略。迦太基方面，漢尼拔雖然贏了會戰，卻拿不下羅馬城，也拿不下卡西利努姆、諾拉與塔倫圖姆這些堅城，圍城與僵局消耗了他在義大利唯一的優勢，也就是快速機動與奇襲。整場戰爭的走向因此被這一天定下：漢尼拔再沒有第二次全殲羅馬主力軍的機會，羅馬則學會了用海權與耐心而不是用正面會戰去贏。軍事史上，坎尼式的兩翼包抄自此成為經典範本，被後世無數兵書引用；羅馬的軍制反思也從這裡開始，雖然真正的改革要等到共和國末期才完成。
impactEn: The effect of Cannae falls half inside the battlefield and half outside it. Inside, it was the gravest loss of a pitched battle the Roman Republic had suffered since its foundation: one of the two consuls was killed, both consular armies and a large part of the allied contingents were destroyed, Rome's ability to fight a field battle in Apulia was reduced to almost nothing, wide areas of central and southern Italy were left undefended for months, and for the first time an organised enemy army stood outside the walls of Rome. Outside, the whole strategy for dealing with Hannibal was rearranged. Since the army had to be rebuilt, Rome turned its resources towards the fleet and towards Spain: the two detachments sent to Iberia in 218 BC went on the offensive, Publius Cornelius Scipio crossed to Spain in 206 BC, took New Carthage in 209 BC, and in 207 BC killed Hannibal's brother Hasdrubal at the Metaurus, cutting off any further flow of men and money from Carthage to Italy. At home Rome turned to defence and delay: Quintus Fabius Maximus was made dictator in 215 BC and wore Hannibal down by refusing a quick decision, harassing him with small cavalry forces and cutting his supplies, an approach later called the Fabian strategy. On the Carthaginian side, Hannibal had won the battle but could not take Rome, and could not take Casilinum, Nola or Tarentum either; sieges and stalemates consumed the one advantage he had in Italy, which was speed of movement and surprise. The course of the war was therefore settled on that single day: Hannibal would never again have the chance to annihilate a Roman field army, and Rome learned that the way to beat Carthage was through sea power and patience rather than through a set-piece battle. In the history of military art the double envelopment of Cannae became a classic model quoted in countless later manuals, and the Roman rethinking of its army system began here, though the actual reforms only came at the end of the Republic.
result: 西元前216年8月2日，羅馬的兩支執政官軍隊在阿普利亞平原被全毀。迦太基方面的損失有限，波里比烏斯記約五千七百人；羅馬方面則是數萬人被殺、被俘，大批俘虜被賣作奴隸，執政官盧基烏斯·埃米利烏斯·保盧斯陣亡，馬爾凱盧斯帶著殘部退回卡西利努姆。從戰術上看，漢尼拔完成了一次教科書式的殲滅戰；從戰略上看，他立刻撞上另一道題：迦太基沒有攻城器械與足夠兵力，羅馬的城牆擋在前面，義大利的城市一個個關上門，卡西利努姆的守軍在圍城之後仍然死守，諾拉與塔倫圖姆接連成為僵局。戰爭因此進入長期的消耗與拉鋸：羅馬以海軍重建對西班牙的攻勢，前203年西庇阿返回義大利，前202年扎馬戰役中漢尼拔戰敗於西庇阿·阿非利加之手，前201年迦太基求和。卡納的勝利最終沒有改變迦太基的結局，卻改變了整場戰爭的路線：它讓羅馬學會了一件事，正面消滅迦太基的最佳戰場在西班牙和非洲，不在亞普利亞的平原上。
resultEn: On 2 August 216 BC both Roman consular armies were destroyed on the Apulian plain. Carthaginian losses were light, about five thousand seven hundred according to Polybius; on the Roman side tens of thousands were killed and taken, a large number of the prisoners were sold into slavery, the consul Lucius Aemilius Paullus fell in the fighting, and Marcellus took the remnants back to Casilinum. Tactically Hannibal had carried out a textbook annihilation; strategically he immediately ran into a different problem: Carthage had neither siege engines nor the numbers to use them, the walls of Rome stood in the way, the Italian cities shut their gates one by one, the garrison of Casilinum held out through the siege, and Nola and Tarentum in turn became deadlocks. The war therefore settled into a long contest of attrition: Rome rebuilt its offensive in Spain with the fleet, Scipio returned to Italy in 203 BC, Hannibal was beaten at Zama in 202 BC by Scipio Africanus, and in 201 BC Carthage sued for peace. The victory at Cannae did not change the end of the Carthaginian story, but it changed the route of the whole war: it taught Rome that the best ground on which to destroy Carthage lay in Spain and Africa, and not on the plain of Apulia.
